headline: Executive order changes the rules on extra pay and benefits for certain federal employees working outside the United States.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 10000, which sets rules for extra pay and related credit given to some federal employees stationed outside the United States. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees working outside the United States
who_it_affects.how: The rules for the extra pay or credit they may receive for serving abroad are changed in some way not described in the title.
